name: Monster Girls School
source:
Monster Girls Academy is a school romance visual novel with 3 heroines, where you represent the human side on a committee meant to bring monsters and humans together.

Welcome to Amano High, where monsters and humans come together. A mysterious school life filled with intrigue and beautiful monster girls begins now. Are you ready for the adventure?

■ Story ■
After enrolling in a coeducational high school for both humans and monsters, you join the Human-Demi-Human Relations Committee. As the human representative, your role is to promote harmony among the students. Some demi-humans are eager to cooperate; others stir up conflict and unrest. Can you overcome these obstacles and bring everyone together before the school festival?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.monstertransfer&hl=en]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
《魔物娘学园》是一部拥有3名可攻略女主角的校园恋爱视觉小说，你将作为人类方代表加入一个旨在促进魔物与人类和谐共处的委员会。

欢迎来到魔物与人类共同就读的天野高中。充满阴谋暗流与美艳魔物娘的奇妙校园生活即将拉开帷幕。准备好迎接这场冒险了吗？

■故事简介■
升入一所招收人类与魔物的男女混校后，你加入了“人类与亚人交流委员会”。作为人类代表，你的职责是促进学生之间的和睦相处。有些亚人积极配合，另一些却蓄意挑起冲突与骚乱。你能否克服重重阻碍，在学园祭到来之前让大家团结一心？

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.monstertransfer&hl=en]Google Play[/url]]
